allowed_deltas: the header names its new home and shapes

coverage(pieces, checks) is the --coverage report of scripts/method-sources.mjs:150-160 over piece rows instead of a sources file: per file, pieces, with a check, with a reason, uncovered by name, and status failed when any is uncovered
coverageInRecords reads the piece rows and the checks they name through the records door, read only

coverageInRecords reads in bounded pages only (records:list: the ids of the Checks list with fields [], then the piece rows by where { kind: piece } narrowed to the fields the coverage reads) and folds each page into a running tally (coverageTally), never holding the list or reading a check one by one: a list of 40,707 rows (39,088 pieces) answered with an unknown outcome reading the whole list in one go

the answer fits one door message (read-data/pieces.json answer.most_bytes): totals and every file's counts are whole, the files shown and the pieces named are those that fit, and next pages on over every file or, with file, over one file's uncovered pieces

a write to the person's records
a pass while any piece is uncovered
